name: RC2A3_SHOW_EDITOR
source: git: markingartist-hash/il_secchione, branch of PR #1 on top of RC2-A.2 (fcf228d)
scope: Show UX fix after the classroom review of RC2-A.2 and start of Phase B1: persistent teacher-controlled game curtain (no early exposure on the projector), dedicated full-screen layouts per game without mascot/logo, Pack Studio 'create from scratch' for every content type, Abbinamenti editor with items A–D and pairs, optional curtain instruction. Scoring unchanged.
changes: Curtain (arcade.curtain) replaces the short intro: stays until the teacher removes it (TOGLI TENDINA E AVVIA / TOGLI TENDINA / MOSTRA TENDINA, key T); public stage HTML contains only the curtain; regia preview shows the prepared game with a notice

gameFrame + dedicated layouts (photoLayout, indLayout, matchLayout, ghWrap, chainPath); no mascot, no logo, compact header timer; stage-fit fitGame on .gameScreen, fitCurtain (--cs); games and curtain fill 4:3

Pack Studio: CREA DA ZERO bar (domanda, Photopuzzle, Indovina, Abbinamento, Parola Segreta, Staffetta); Abbinamento with images / items A–D / pairs and clear validation; optional instruction per game; shortcut from regia GIOCHI tab
packs.js: optional 'instruction' (<=160 chars) on every game, ignored by older versions
Fixed pre-existing Pack Studio error when a draft is closed right after an edit

previous.name: RC2A2_GAMEPLAY
previous.scope: Gameplay patch after a real classroom test. No Phase B, no new games, no pack changes. Game readability on the stage, game intro screen, RESULT OF THE GAME, clear scoring texts, Ghigliottina +10 per A/B choice and final 200–300, Chain 50–100 per word, manual rank 300/290… (chain 100/95…), caret text field on the player keyboard.

knownLimitations: Real projector legibility, real tablets and classroom rhythm not verified.
Popup projector window not exercised in the automated browser; /show tested at 1366x768, 1600x900, 1920x1080, 1024x768.
Abbinamenti stays at exactly 4 images / 4 items (engine and pack format).
Abbinamenti item names in 4:3 are slightly smaller than in RC2-A.2 (5.4% vs 5.6% of height) because the images are larger.
Barocco/Preistoria and external packs keep explicit 30/60 s until the Phase B command.
simulatePlayers: 2/6/15/30 devices, no lost or duplicated responses
manualQA: Real-browser QA (Playwright + Chromium): visual_games.cjs 84 screenshots at 4 resolutions with curtain leak checks, keyboard_caret.cjs 13 checks, studio_create.cjs 9 checks. See documentazione_tecnica/QA/TEST_RESULTS_1.0_RC2A3.md
contentPacks: Barocco 3media and Preistoria 1media 1.2.0 (standard times) delivered separately, not inside this ZIP
